comparison.objective: Insert a hose adapter into a camlock coupler and close both cams.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxially align and insert mating cylindrical parts, then actuate two latches; no hammer impact or intentional fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Adapter seated, both cams closed, and robot released and withdrawn; insertion depth, latch-force, seal, and damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: This is the closest alignment-related record, but its tested outcome is insertion and latching of a reusable coupling, not fracture at a notch, protection of a retained coil, and recovery of released fragments.
